# npm.io

> > npm.io is a comprehensive NPM package registry explorer providing detailed metadata, documentation, and reference information for JavaScript packages published to npm.

The site serves as a package discovery and documentation platform for the npm ecosystem, offering detailed views of package versions, dependencies, licenses, and utilities ranging from lodash-inspired helpers to CLI tools and specialized libraries.

## Key Topics

- npm packages
- JavaScript utilities
- package metadata
- ISC license
- lodash-inspired utilities
- CLI tools
- npx business cards
- function utilities (throttle, debounce, call, apply, bind)
- ES6 features
- package dependencies
- array manipulation methods
- deprecated packages
- Chrome USB libraries
- one-liner tools

## NPM Package Reference

- [01slc_unsolved NPM](https://npm.io/package/01slc_unsolved): NPM package details for 01slc_unsolved v1.0.0 with ISC license
- [0216tool_xiaoye NPM](https://npm.io/package/0216tool_xiaoye): NPM package details for 0216tool_xiaoye v1.2.0 lodash-inspired utilities
- [07gond NPM](https://npm.io/package/07gond): NPM package details for 07gond v1.3.1 npx business card by Gerson Niño
- [1-liners-cli NPM](https://npm.io/package/1-liners-cli): NPM package details for 1-liners-cli v1.0.3 JavaScript one-liner tool
- [1-wire-js NPM](https://npm.io/package/1-wire-js): NPM package details for 1-wire-js v1.4.3 Chrome USB 1-Wire protocol lib
